children: AI conversation analytics firm's Q3 revenue rose yr/yr to $16.0 mln
Adjusted EPS for Q3 was $0.04, up from a loss last year
Company sees early commercial momentum after Archenia acquisition, appoints Travis Fairchild president
Marchex sees Q4 2026 revenue of $15 mln or more
Company expects Q4 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $2.3 mln to $2.5 mln
Company notes Q4 typically impacted by seasonality, but sees potential to offset with sales pipeline
ARCHENIA ACQUISITION - Co said early commercial momentum followed its July acquisition of Archenia, including expanded customer relationships and new AI-powered solution deployments
AUTOMOTIVE OEM CHANNEL - Co received approval from a major automotive OEM to offer its Engage for Service solution through the OEM’s dealer portal, expanding distribution opportunities
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the advertising & marketing peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Marchex Inc is $4.00, about 207.7% above its November 9 closing price of $1.30
